description: Geometry replay of LRML without the regularizer max-ratio cap (regularizer_max_ratio = null); 600 epochs / patience 10 (Semi-iNat's Phase-1 patience, as its earlier tracking runs). Uncapped epoch tracking (track_epoch_max_samples = 0): the whole fold training pool, all validation classes and the whole test set, as Roth et al. (2020) measure on the whole training set.
name: geometry_lrml_uncapped_semi_inat
